name: project_gallery
title: Project Gallery
summary: Photo gallery section of a project page.
description: Photo gallery section of a project page (folders found by utility_project_media): one filter chip per folder with its count ("All" first), a masonry grid (every image at its own shape, the first one bigger on "All", logos on the canvas color), a label per tile (folder + number), "Showing X of Y" with Load more / Show all, and the popup gallery of the visible frames. Default folder: media (media/<sub folders>). A <section> of its own with a section_head.
